name: zapcart-agent
description: AI-powered content creation agent for Zapcart

scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d && npm run migrate && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
